category-specific filters/order and limit metadata; zero-match files
inventory-only global item history and located whole transactions
export reads leave storage rows, journal flags and completeness semantics unchanged
bounded UTF8 writer, snapshot budgets, directory quota and partial cleanup
actual LuckPerms export/category grants remain independent; cached completions after revocation
operator level four gate independently tested on both loaders
paused read then permission withdrawal, requester cancellation, foreign cancellation refusal, stop and successful publication
completed exports retained after permission loss
server restart preserves files and history; SQLite integrity; final hashes match every runtime/permission copy
limits: Export is a bounded extract, not a database backup or import/restore format.

One active export; fewer than 64 entries required in the export directory; completed files are never automatically deleted.

Only generated server-local paths; no client download or caller-selected destination.
